603:     pub(super) fn zmodem_bar(&self, cx: &mut Context<Self>) -> Option<AnyElement> {
604:         if self.zmodem.current.is_none() && self.zmodem.unresolved.is_empty() {
605:             return None;
606:         }
607:         let visual = crate::design::palette(cx);
608:         let mut body = div()
609:             .id("zmodem-review-body")
610:             .test_support()
611:             .max_h(px(190.))
612:             .overflow_y_scroll()
613:             .text_xs()
614:             .flex()
615:             .flex_col()
616:             .gap_2();
617:         let mut actions = div()
618:             .id("zmodem-review-actions")
619:             .test_support()
620:             .flex()
621:             .items_center()
622:             .flex_wrap()
623:             .gap_2();
624:         let local_supported = cfg!(any(target_os = "linux", target_os = "macos"));
625:         if !local_supported {
626:             body = body.child(div().whitespace_normal().child(t(cx,
627:                 "当前平台的 Zmodem 本地文件安全后端尚未完成，可以取消本次协议请求。",
628:                 "This platform's safe local Zmodem file backend is pending. Cancel this protocol request.",
629:             )));
630:         }
631:         if let Some(current) = &self.zmodem.current {
632:             let id = current.id;
633:             body = body
634:                 .child(div().whitespace_normal().child(current.summary.render(cx)))
635:                 .child(
636:                     div()
637:                         .id("zmodem-feedback")
638:                         .aria_label(current.feedback.render(cx))
639:                         .child(current.feedback.render(cx)),
640:                 );
641:             let picker_pending = current.picker.is_some();
642:             actions = match &current.stage {
643:                 Stage::Upload => actions.child(
644:                     Button::new("zmodem-choose-upload")
645:                         .small()
646:                         .primary()
647:                         .label(t(cx, "选择上传文件", "Choose upload files"))
648:                         .disabled(picker_pending || !local_supported)
649:                         .on_click(cx.listener(move |view, _, window, cx| {
650:                             view.choose_zmodem_sources(id, window, cx)
651:                         })),
652:                 ),
653:                 Stage::Download { .. } => actions.child(
654:                     Button::new("zmodem-choose-destination")
655:                         .small()
656:                         .primary()
657:                         .label(t(cx, "选择新本地文件", "Choose new local file"))
658:                         .disabled(picker_pending || !local_supported)
659:                         .on_click(cx.listener(move |view, _, window, cx| {
660:                             view.choose_zmodem_destination(id, window, cx)
661:                         })),
662:                 ),
663:                 Stage::Review { review } => {
664:                     let review = *review;
665:                     actions.child(
666:                         Button::new("zmodem-confirm")
667:                             .small()
668:                             .primary()
669:                             .label(t(cx, "确认本次传输", "Confirm this transfer"))
670:                             .on_click(cx.listener(move |view, _, _, cx| {
671:                                 view.zmodem_control(
672:                                     ZmodemControl::Confirm {
673:                                         transfer: id,
674:                                         review,
675:                                     },
676:                                     cx,
677:                                 )
678:                             })),
679:                     )
680:                 }
681:                 Stage::Running | Stage::Cancelling => actions,
682:                 Stage::Ended => actions.child(
683:                     Button::new("zmodem-dismiss")
684:                         .small()
685:                         .ghost()
686:                         .label(t(cx, "收起回执", "Hide receipt"))
687:                         .on_click(cx.listener(move |view, _, _, cx| {
688:                             if view.zmodem.current.as_ref().is_some_and(|current| {
689:                                 current.id == id && matches!(current.stage, Stage::Ended)
690:                             }) {
691:                                 view.zmodem.current = None;
692:                             }
693:                             cx.notify();
694:                         })),
695:                 ),
696:             };
697:             if !matches!(current.stage, Stage::Ended) {
698:                 actions = actions.child(
699:                     Button::new("zmodem-cancel")
700:                         .small()
701:                         .ghost()
702:                         .label(t(cx, "取消 Zmodem", "Cancel Zmodem"))
703:                         .disabled(matches!(current.stage, Stage::Cancelling))
704:                         .on_click(cx.listener(move |view, _, _, cx| {
705:                             view.zmodem_control(ZmodemControl::Cancel { transfer: id }, cx)
706:                         })),
707:                 );
708:             }
709:         }
710:         if !self.zmodem.verified_saves.is_empty() {
711:             body = body.child(div().font_semibold().child(t(
712:                 cx,
713:                 "已验证保存的文件（保留最近 32 条）",
714:                 "Verified saved files (latest 32 retained)",
715:             )));
716:             for (index, saved) in self.zmodem.verified_saves.iter().enumerate() {
717:                 let summary = saved.summary().render(cx);
718:                 body = body.child(
719:                     div()
720:                         .id(("zmodem-verified-save", index))
721:                         .test_support()
722:                         .aria_label(summary.clone())
723:                         .flex_shrink_0()
724:                         .whitespace_normal()
725:                         .child(summary),
726:                 );
727:             }
728:         }
729:         for summary in self.zmodem.unresolved.values() {
730:             body = body.child(
731:                 div()
732:                     .text_color(rgb(visual.warning))
733:                     .whitespace_normal()
734:                     .child(summary.render(cx)),
735:             );
736:         }
737:         if !self.zmodem.unresolved.is_empty() {
738:             let reviewing = self.zmodem.acknowledge_review.is_some();
739:             if reviewing {
740:                 body = body.child(t(
741:                     cx,
742:                     "请检查以上每个原始目标和临时文件。再次确认仅允许关闭窗口，不代表传输成功、回滚、清理或解除文件隔离。",
743:                     "Inspect every original destination and staging file above. Confirming again permits window closing only; it does not establish success, rollback, cleanup or removal of file quarantine.",
744:                 ));
745:             }
746:             actions = actions.child(
747:                 Button::new("zmodem-acknowledge-unknown")
748:                     .small()
749:                     .ghost()
750:                     .label(if reviewing {
751:                         t(
752:                             cx,
753:                             "已核对，确认未知结果",
754:                             "Inspected: acknowledge unknown outcomes",
755:                         )
756:                     } else {
757:                         t(cx, "核对未知结果", "Review unknown outcomes")
758:                     })
759:                     .disabled(self.zmodem_input_blocked())
760:                     .on_click(cx.listener(|view, _, _, cx| view.acknowledge_zmodem_outcomes(cx))),
761:             );
762:         }
763:         Some(
764:             div()
765:                 .id("zmodem-transfer")
766:                 .test_support()
767:                 .occlude()
768:                 .capture_any_mouse_down(
769:                     cx.listener(|view, _, _, cx| view.publish_input_selection(cx)),
770:                 )
771:                 .track_focus(&self.zmodem_focus)
772:                 .absolute()
773:                 .bottom_2()
774:                 .left_2()
775:                 .right_2()
776:                 .p_3()
777:                 .rounded_md()
778:                 .border_1()
779:                 .border_color(rgb(visual.border))
780:                 .bg(rgb(visual.surface))
781:                 .text_color(rgb(visual.text))
782:                 .flex()
783:                 .flex_col()
784:                 .gap_2()
785:                 .child(div().font_semibold().text_sm().child("Zmodem"))
786:                 .child(body)
787:                 .child(actions)
788:                 .into_any_element(),
789:         )
